title: Surreal Mosaic Fairy
description: A central female figure with large golden wings stands in a highly detailed surreal dreamscape. Her bodysuit is covered in a vibrant mosaic of flowers and reflective mirror tiles, one arm raised as a beam of light shines down upon her.
prompt: A beautiful fairy woman with large translucent golden wings stands at the center of a chaotic surreal dream world. Her futuristic bodysuit is composed of intricate floral mosaic patterns and reflective mirror tiles. One arm is raised toward a beam of divine light from above. The scene is filled with floating eyeballs, jellyfish, black ravens, melting clocks draped over stairs, a small golden dog, a red and blue snake, a framed painting of a dark castle, and crumbling stone ruins under a cosmic sky.
